en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a complex of large brick and stucco hospital buildings surrounded by trees, gardens, and what appears to be vineyards on a hillside. In the distant left background a windmill stands on a ridge. The architecture features steep, gabled roofs with dormer windows and decorative spires. At the bottom center, printed text in German identifies the view as the municipal hospital in Meissen on the Elbe River.
